description: Per-character battle/lobby symbol-chat text and voice line lists. Indexed by the EGameChatLabel of a ChatDataTable entry, they supply the localized text ID and the voice ID played when a character sends a predefined chat message.

ID.simple: Row key, normally the character ID (CP_xxx / CN_xxx).
ID.technical: FName primary key (ImportKeyField=Id in the export). GameCharacter::Setup resolves Character::Id_CharacterChat against CharacterChatDataTables (DTM +0x550) and caches the result as GameCharacter::ChatRow (+0x3E0); UI widgets also call the same finder directly with Character::Id_CharacterChat. A None/empty id fails the row lookup, leaving no chat row.

Id_ChatText.simple: Text IDs for each predefined chat message, one per chat label.
Id_ChatText.technical: TArray<FName> indexed by GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Chat->ChatLabel) = static_cast<int32>(Label) - 1, where ChatLabel is the EGameChatLabel on the ChatDataTable row (1-based enum starting at Greeting_1; the exported arrays have 58 entries, matching the label range). Values are text IDs (e.g. CP_010_GREETING_1) handed to IGameWidgetTextSettingInterface::SetTextIdOnly, ShowSymbolChatMessage or stored as FGameChatMessageRequest::TextId. Some consumers bounds-check the slot, others copy the array and index it unguarded. This table has no per-locale variants: localization is downstream through the text ID.

Id_Voice.simple: Voice IDs for the same predefined chat messages, parallel to Id_ChatText.
Id_Voice.technical: TArray<FName> indexed with the same Label-1 slot. When the slot is valid, AGameSoundManager::PlayVoiceById(Id_Voice[Slot], characterIndex) plays the line, with the character index used as the speaker/player index. Battle chat suppresses voice for characters in BlockedCommunicationCharacterIndices and for level-report labels can change the slot according to clamped cursed-energy level (0x21/0x22/0x23). Some consumers check IsValidIndex before playback; others do not. 58 entries in every exported row, paired with Id_ChatText.

notes: Export contains 27 rows; all have exactly 58 parallel Id_ChatText and Id_Voice entries.

The shared accessor GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Type) = Type - 1 maps the 1-based EGameChatLabel enum to the arrays; EGameChatLabel::None is 0 (index -1), so callers rely on a real Chat row label in 1..58.

The same cached Character::ChatRow is reused from battle symbol-chat playback, battle results, situation-overview chat bubbles, customize chat tile views and interval/PvE widgets; several of those paths have no null check.
No per-locale CharacterChatDataTable variants exist in the export; only the downstream text IDs are localization keys. No claim is made about additional retail rows or Blueprint-only uses.
Reconstructed C++ with cited retail RVAs; reconstruction does not by itself prove byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: Caches the row on AGameCharacter::ChatRow from Character::Id_CharacterChat.
Looks up text and voice by chat label and displays/voices the message.
Battle symbol-chat uses Id_ChatText for the message and Id_Voice for playback, including level-report slot remapping.
Direct table lookup and bounds-checked text/voice selection for chat messages.
Result-screen chat bubbles use Speaker's cached CharacterChat row.
Customize chat list copies Id_ChatText and indexes by the selected Chat row's label.
